start: Owner online, Diet plans, no plans yet

steps.action: Tap the new-plan button; in 'New diet plan' pick a ready-made plan under 'Veg' or 'Non-veg' (or 'Start empty')
user_sees: Title 'Diet plans', subtitle 'Send members what to eat'
'No diet plans yet'
'Each ready-made plan is for an adult of about 60 to 70 kg who trains 3 to 5 days a week. It uses everyday Indian food and is not medical advice.'
must_not: A ready-made plan sent to anyone before it is saved

steps.action: Change 'Plan name', 'Goal (optional)', 'Calories a day (optional)', 'Protein a day (optional)', a meal ('Meal', 'Time (optional)', 'Food, one per line'), 'Notes for the member (optional)'; tick members; save
user_sees: Toast '“<name>” saved and sent.' (or '“<name>” saved. Tick members to send it.' with nobody ticked)
The plan under 'Plans'
must_not: Two plans from a double tap
The plan sent to a member who was not ticked
The last meal removable (one meal must stay)

start: Owner online, on a member’s page, the Diet plan part

steps.action: Tap to send a plan; in 'Send a diet plan to <name>' tap a plan under 'Your gym’s diet plans'
user_sees: Row reads 'Sending…'
Toast '“<plan>” sent to <name>.'
'Already sent' on that plan next time
must_not: The plan sent to another member
Sent twice
Other rows tappable while one sends

steps.action: Or under 'Make one for them' tap 'Start from a ready-made plan' or 'Write a new plan' and save
user_sees: Toast '“<plan>” saved and sent to <name>.'
must_not: The new plan sent to every member

start: Owner online, on a member’s page, 'Body measurements', none yet

steps.action: Tap the add button; in 'Add measurements' fill 'Day measured', 'Body weight (kg)', 'Body fat (%)', 'Tape measurements (cm)', 'Desk note (only your gym sees it)'; tap 'Save'
user_sees: 'No measurements yet' before
Button reads 'Saving…'
Toast 'Measurements saved. <name> sees them in the MettleUp app.'
must_not: The desk note shown to the member
Two rows for one save
The measurements saved on another member

start: Owner on the diet editor and the measurements sheet; also with the gym not online

steps.action: Save a diet plan with no name or an empty meal; save measurements with letters or a far-off number in a box, or a future day
user_sees: A plain problem line under the wrong box or above the buttons
must_not: A plan or measurement saved with a wrong value
The typed values wiped

steps.action: Open Diet plans with the gym not online or the server part missing
user_sees: 'Diet plans need your gym online' or 'Diet plans are not switched on for your gym yet'
On the member page: 'Measurements are kept on your gym’s server. Put your gym online first (Settings → Sign-in & data).'
must_not: An endless Loading…
A save that looks done but is not

start: Owner online; one plan sent to two members, one measurement saved

steps.action: Edit the plan ('Edit diet plan') and save; make a copy; on a member tap 'Stop sending <plan> to <name>'
user_sees: Toast '“<plan>” updated.'
Toast '<name> no longer gets “<plan>”.'
must_not: The other member loses the plan too
The copy sent to the same members without ticking

steps.action: Tap the withdraw button; in 'Withdraw this plan?' confirm
user_sees: Toast 'Plan withdrawn.'
The plan under a list with 'Members no longer get these.' with only a copy button
must_not: Members still shown the withdrawn plan
The withdrawn plan editable

steps.action: On the member page tap the fix button of a measurement ('Fix measurements'), save; then delete it via 'Delete these measurements?'
user_sees: Toast 'Measurements updated.'
Button reads 'Deleting…'; the row is gone
'Numbers in brackets show the change since the previous measurement.' still adds up
must_not: The member’s own body weight entries in their app deleted
A wrong change-since figure after the delete

start: Owner saves a measurement with a desk note for a member

steps.action: Read the hint lines, then think of what the member sees
user_sees: 'Members see these in their MettleUp app (Progress → Body) after they check in at the gym once.'
'Desk note (only your gym sees it)'
must_not: The desk note in the member app
One member’s measurements or diet plan shown to another member
A member who never checked in at the gym getting the data
